plan.title: Feature change
plan.why: Deliver a scoped feature change with a reviewable implementation path.
plan.what:
## Scope

- State the user problem and the intended outcome.
- List what is in and out of scope.

## Commit strategy

- Implement, test, refactor, and document in separate green commits.

milestones.title: Deliver the feature
milestones.desc: As a user, I want the feature, so that the outcome is visible. Add inputs and prerequisites.

tasks.title: Implement the feature
tasks.desc:
Approach: name the code path and edge cases.

Commit: implementation slice.

Verify: the relevant test suite passes.

tasks.title: Test the feature
tasks.desc:
Approach: cover the acceptance criteria and edge cases.

Commit: test slice.

Verify: the new tests pass.

tasks.title: Refactor the touched code
tasks.desc:
Approach: simplify the touched area without behavior change.

Commit: refactor slice.

Verify: the full test suite passes.

tasks.title: Update the documentation
tasks.desc:
Approach: document the new behavior and commands.

Commit: docs slice.

Verify: links and examples resolve.
